description: Header file defining the GpuVideoDecoderBase class for a platform-specific GPU video decoder, including nested classes for frame buffers and decoded images, with methods for initialization, decoding, and resource management.

classes.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for GPU video decoding, managing platform-specific resources, decoding workflow, and frame buffers.

classes.name: GpuFrameBuffer
classes.description: Reference-counted class managing D3D textures and resources for a video frame.

classes.name: DecodedImage
classes.description: Reference-counted class representing a decoded video frame with associated metadata and textures.

methods.name: ReleaseFrameBuffer
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a frame buffer.

methods.name: GetWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the current frame.

methods.name: GetHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the current frame.

methods.name: IsHdrVideo
methods.description: Indicates whether the video is HDR.

methods.name: ClearFrameBuffersPool
methods.description: Clears the pool of frame buffers.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of frames to preroll.

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for prerolling.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of cached frames.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target.

methods.name: InitializeCodecIfNeededInternal
methods.description: Pure virtual: initializes the codec if needed.

methods.name: DecodeInternal
methods.description: Pure virtual: decodes a given input buffer.

methods.name: DrainDecoderInternal
methods.description: Pure virtual: drains the decoder.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFramesInternal
methods.description: Pure virtual: returns max cached frames for derived class.

methods.name: BelongsToDecoderThread
methods.description: Checks if current thread is the decoder thread.

methods.name: OnDecoderDrained
methods.description: Handles decoder drained event.

methods.name: ClearCachedImages
methods.description: Clears cached decoded images.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error with a message.

methods.name: OnOutputRetrieved
methods.description: Handles output image retrieval.

methods.name: AllocateFrameBuffers
methods.description: Allocates frame buffers for given dimensions.

methods.name: GetAvailableFrameBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves an available frame buffer matching dimensions.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end of stream decoding.

methods.name: DrainDecoder
methods.description: Drains the decoder.

methods.name: DeleteVideoFrame
methods.description: Deletes a video frame.

methods.name: UpdateHdrMetadata
methods.description: Updates HDR metadata.

methods.name: ClearPresentingDecodeTargets
methods.description: Clears current decode targets.
